sheoke sanada.name: Sheoke Sanada
sheoke sanada.origin: left|thumb|Snapdragon (Sheoke Sanada) A skilled martial artist, Snapdragon was first seen when she was hired to defeat the Black Widow in Japan. She succeeded in this mission, but Black Widow soon regained her composure and quickly dispatched Snapdragon. Later, Snapdragon joined Superia's all-female superhuman army the Femizons and became one of her lieutenants. There, Snapdragon came across another Femizon recruit, her long-time enemy Diamondback. The two had both been trained by Anaconda in Taskmaster's Academy for training criminal mercenaries, but Diamondback had subsequently dishonored Snapdragon in some way. While on Superia's S.S. Superia cruise ship, Snapdragon faced Diamondback when she was without her trademark throwing diamond weapons. The two fought, and Snapdragon knocked Diamondback unconscious. Snapdragon threw the unconscious Diamondback overboard, leaving her to drown. Diamondback was rescued and eventually recovered, but briefly swore off her life as a costumed mercenary out of fear of dying. After being brutalized and trained by the criminal Crossbones, Diamondback returned to her life of adventuring and sought revenge against Snapdragon. Diamondback tracked Snapdragon to an AIM weapons expo on the island Boca Caliente with her allies Captain America and Falcon and caught Snapdragon unawares. During their rematch, a now more highly trained and ruthless Diamondback overpowered and strangled Snapdragon to death in a fountain. Snapdragon's body was returned to Japan and cremated by her brother, Kono. thumb|Echo breaks her cover to save Moon Knight from Snapdragon ===Side by side with Moon Knight=== Snapdragon somehow returned to life and started working for the Los Angeles Kingpin. Some time later she was confronted by Moon Knight. She and her henchmen got the best of him. However, he was saved by an undercover Echo. Snapdragon hired Night Shift to kill Moon Knight, but the team failed. After Moon Knight and Echo managed to reveal Count Nefaria as the Kingpin, a subdued Snapdragon was left to the police. More recently, Snapdragon worked with Viper, Arcade, and others to gain revenge on Black Widow.

shep mason.name: Shep Mason
shep mason.origin: Shep Mason and his gang robbed gold shipments heading to Lawson City. He then returned to town a few days later with the stolen loot and cashed it in at the local assayer and drank away his spoils. He bragged about having "found" a mine but would never reveal its location. His boasting came to the ears of Mexican Pete, companion of the Masked Raider. When the Raider got involved in solving the thefts, he baited a trap for Mason and his men: Loading gold samples with a lead solution, the Raider allowed Mason and his men to rob the next shipment without opposition. Later, when he cashed in his stolen loot, the lead inside gave away the fact that it was stolen. With all the proof they needed, the Masked Raider and Mexican Pete rounded up Mason and his men. Later in the Lawson City jail, the once boastful Shep Mason was told by the Raider how he was easily tricked into capture.
shep mason.bio: Shep Mason and his gang robbed gold shipments heading to Lawson City. He bragged about having "found" a mine but would never reveal its location. His boasting came to the ears of Mexican Pete, companion of the Masked Raider. When the Raider got involved in solving the thefts, he baited a trap for Mason and his men: Loading gold samples with a lead solution, the Raider allowed Mason and his men to rob the next shipment without opposition. Later, when he cashed in his stolen loot, the lead inside gave away the fact that it was stolen. With all the proof they needed, the Masked Raider and Mexican Pete rounded up Mason and his men. Later in the Lawson City jail, the once boastful Shep Mason was told by the Raider how he was easily tricked into capture.
weapons: Armed with a six shooter.

sheriff darrell.name: Sheriff Darrell
sheriff darrell.first_appearance: Immortal Hulk: The Threshing Place Vol 1 1
sheriff darrell.origin: Darrell was the sheriff of a town in Toews County. He helped cover up the operations of the Toews County Experimental Farm, which was using gamma radiation to grow crops. When a local girl named Rebecca Green wandered off into the farm, she got mutated into a disfigured monster which terrorized the town, killing three people over three days. When Bruce Banner traveled to this town to investigate Rebecca's disappearance, he found out the experimental farm. When he was being confronted by Rebecca's father Rick for snooping around, having also found him holding Rebecca's hair clip, Darrell and an officer named Les approached them. They arrested Banner, and Darrell brutalized him in the process. At night, the mutated Rebecca rampaged downtown, drawn to Banner's gamma energy. In the process, she attacked Darrell, leaving him trapped under a car with an extensive gash across his torso. When Banner transformed into the Hulk and escaped prison, he stumbled into the result of Rebecca's rampage. He approached Darrell and stepped on him for not warning the locals of the truth behind the experimental farm, killing him.

sheriff studdard.name: Sheriff Studdard
sheriff studdard.origin: Sheriff Studdard was the popular yet extremely intolerant head of the Daly County Police Department. Ever since his election, hate crimes skyrocketed in Daly County. When the Champions caught notice of the hate crime wave in Daly County, they confronted Sheriff Studdard after saving some innocent people trapped in a burning mosque. Viv recovered an incendiary device inside the mosque, and once she analysed it, she found out it was a bomb originally impounded by Studdard's department. Studdard tried to claim the fragments as evidence, but Viv refused. Sheriff Studdard later berated Deputy Sims for the presence of the Champions on the roof of his precinct.

sherlock dog.name: Sherlock (Dog)
sherlock dog.origin: Sherlock was a labradoodle rescued by Austin Van Der Sleet. Fearing that M.O.D.O.K. and others at A.I.M. were not responding well to his management style, Austin brought in Sherlock to help deliver bad news including confronting M.O.D.O.K. about not delivering the mail and telling Dillman the police were coming due to his "ruff" internet searches. Since rescuing him, Austin had become very close to Sherlock. Wanting to have a companion in his loneliness, Austin asked Hexus the Living Corporation if Sherlock could be spared from the culling of their invasion. When this request was denied, Austin began to work against Hexus' plan. After Hexus told him to kill Sherlock immediately, Austin looked in Monica's lab for technology, hiding in Monica's teleporter once she arrived, causing Austin and Sherlock to merge into a freakish hybrid. When M.O.D.O.K. was able to sell both his and Monica's share to Iron Man, Monica unmerged the two.

sherlock holmes.name: Sherlock Holmes
sherlock holmes.origin: ===Early Life=== Little is known for certain about Mystique's early life. Her shapeshifting powers grant her a lifespan far beyond that of a normal human. It is known that her powers first manifested when she was twelve years old, and that she had to "fight just to survive." ===Destiny=== thumb|250px|left|Raven and Irene Adler Her earliest meeting with Irene Adler, an Austrian mutant with precognitive powers, occurred at the end of the 19th century. She was most accurate in predicting near-future events concerning her present environment. However, during a period of 12 months in her adolescence, Irene had produced 13 volumes of prophecies concerning the late 20th and early 21st centuries. When that period ended, Irene was left physically blind and haunted by disturbing images of uncertain meaning. While known as "Eric Raven" she enlisted her services in pursuit of two goals: the deciphering of her recorded prophecies and a mission to prevent the most terrifying of them from ever being fulfilled. The two women soon became lifelong friends and lovers, but they both discovered that their set goals were difficult to achieve. Their abilities easily allowed them to achieve personal success, but to shape the future proved to be next to impossible as it would require extensive social engineering. ===Sherlock Holmes=== thumb|250px|right|Mystique as Sherlock Holmes. In 1895 (or earlier), Raven took up the identity of consulting detective "Sherlock Holmes" operating out 221B Baker Street in London working with her long term partner Irene Adler. The two were friends with author Sir Arthur Conan Doyle by that time, who wrote down their adventures in his notes and later adapted them into his famous books. The two were hired to investigate a number of murders believing them to have been inspired by Jack the Ripper. They investigated Milbury House the home of Dr. Nathaniel Essex who was discovered at the scene naked and battered but with no memory of the attack. Raven went undercover as a prostitute hoping to lure out the attacker. On that night they found the true attacker "Mr. Sinister", who escaped across the rooftops. They followed him back to Dr. Essex's home they discovered him turning back into the frail Doctor. They arrested him and sent him away to Bedlam to be detained and treated. However overnight they learned that he was murdered. ===The Hound of the Baskervilles=== thumb Mystique, under the guise of Sherlock Holmes and Dr. John Watson were called in to investigate a ghostly, killer dog, which has haunted the Baskerville family for generations, and has apparently killed Sir Charles Baskerville. Sir Henry Baskerville, Charles's only heir, had come back to England to claim his new money and mansion in the creepy countryside. In London, weird things happened to Henry: he received a note warning him not to come to the mansion, two of his shoes were stolen, and someone followed him. When Watson was sent to investigate, "Holmes" followed in secret as he was pretty sure the killer was neighbor Jack Stapleton who used the legend of the ghostly, killer dog to scare Charles to death. "Holmes" was sure Stapleton has something up his sleeve to do away with Henry. It turned out, "Jack Stapleton" was really Henry's cousin Rodger Baskerville, though he kept his mouth shut about it, so no one would know that he was out to get the Baskerville money and mansion. And Beryl is really his wife. Jack used a real dog dabbed with glow-in-the-dark paint to scare Charles to death. He stole Henry's shoe to give the dog his scent. Jack also locked Beryl in her hotel room, but she figured out a way to send Henry a warning to stay away from the mansion. Finally, Jack lured Henry to his house at night, and when Henry was walking home, Jack sicced his mad-dog after him. Holmes shot the dog in the nick of time and chased Jack into a swampy maze of quicksand, where Jack fell to his death. ===First Betrayals=== thumb|150px|left|Raven in Mexico, 1921 In 1921, Raven found herself in the Mexican Sonoran Desert about to be executed by a firing squad; her blue skin had led the locals to believe she was a witch. While she was blindfolded and tied to a post, she noticed a man tied up beside her. When she asked if he was a murderer, He answered: "... worse, a horse thief." Raven managed to untie herself just before the firing squad shot and watched as the man was riddled with bullets. However, he managed to somehow survive and kill the guards. After they both escaped, Raven was surprised that he was still alive and asked how he knew she would be able to free herself and escape. He responded: "I didn't", and when she asked where he was going to next, he said the nearest bar. Raven introduced herself to the man who said his name was Logan, after which she told him that she had a group of friends in Kansas City, that he would probably like to meet. Once in Kansas City, Raven told Logan about her group, who scammed local people. After meeting Raven's crew,

fields.notes: thumb|Mystique|left Mystique has stated that she wasn't born in the last century and that she is "over 100 years old". She is known to have been with her wife Destiny by 1895 and having stated that "solitude was my natural state for a hundred years", it is therefore implied she was born before 1800. In 1921 she met Logan in Kansas City, and they all later worked together in Scotland, shortly before World War II. (However, in an early appearance in , Mystique dreams that she is in the year 1783, which is specified as being 170 years before her birth. As the comic was published in 1983, this would make her 30 years old at the time of the story. This has since been retconned.) Despite the fact that it is unknown when she was born, it can be assumed that she was born in the month of September - she was once given a sapphire necklace, because apparently it was her birthstone (traditionally associated with being born in September), to which she replied 'How did you know when I was born?' Her powers manifested when she was twelve years old. She seldom wears true clothing. Due to the nature of her powers she can simply create clothes from or over her skin, thus eliminating the need for regular clothing or those made from unstable molecules. Because of this she is always naked as she admitted to Shortpack. Mystique cannot stand her own appearance, and therefore never wants to look at her reflection in a mirror. Mystique may be the great-aunt of Clive Reston, as he was hinted to be a relative of Sherlock Holmes, although that was never confirmed. Clive Reston's profile in the states that his great-uncle was "a private detective, from whom Clive inherited deductive reasoning talent and a habit for smoking a meerschaum pipe". The link between Reston's great-uncle and Holmes has never been made explicit, because it was always intended as a joke/Easter egg, and confirming it would ruin that aspect. Bling! once called Mystique "the Sapphic Sapphire" in regards to her significance to the lesbian community.
fields.trivia: Contrary to what is shown in most other incarnations of her in film and television, the comics version of Mystique is not Magneto's second-in-command. In fact, before the two only had a handful of encounters together and barely even knew each other. One depiction of her being an associate of Magneto was the X-Men arcade game by Konami, where she turns herself into Magneto to prevent the players from rescuing Professor X and has all his powers, but is defeated fairly quickly. She turns back into her normal self as Professor X is freed and the players go to the final boss, the real Magneto. Veteran X-Men writer Chris Claremont has stated in interviews that he originally intended for Mystique and Destiny to be Nightcrawler's biological parents (Mystique having morphed into a man for the conception), but Marvel nixed the idea for being too controversial, due to it being a point in time where writers were prevented from having a gay or bisexual character. This was eventually made canon in 2023 in . In celebration of Marvel Comics 80th anniversary, Mystique, along with Dark Phoenix and Storm were featured in a special line of fashion dolls. Mystique was once married to Deadpool. Mystique is bisexual.

sherman wilks.name: Sherman Wilks
sherman wilks.origin: Sherman Wilks was a commander in the Confederate States Army who offered a $1000 death benefit to any man who joined his regiment. After the Confederacy lost the American Civil War, Wilks became a bounty hunter in order to pay off the debt to his men's widows. With only one widow left to pay, Wilks set out to collect the bounty on the outlaw Kid Colt. After a brief truce between the two in order to fight off a gang of scavengers, Wilks challenged Colt to a duel. Wilks lost the duel but ultimately his debt was paid off as Colt and his ally Hawk pretended to be Wilks and collected the bounty, passing off a dead body as that of Kid Colt, using the money to pay Wilks's last widow.

sherna.name: Sherna
sherna.origin: Sherna was one of the last four Followers of the Light on Earth. She was a member of the Lumina race even though she and generations of her ancestors had been born on Earth. Like their ancestors, Sherna and her fellow Followers acted as sentinels against the possible return of their ancient enemies, the Myndai sorcerer-scientist Lord Maur-Kon and his Dark Agents, who had been trapped in suspended animation since the end of the Great Chaos Wars millennia ago. When a volcanic eruption in the early 21st century caused their enemies to finally awaken, Sherna and the other Followers summoned the three humans who their computers had determined would be the best pilots of the Shogun Warrior robots. With the other Followers, Sherna provided support to these three Agents of the Light as they used the Shogun Warriors to battle and defeat various monsters sent against them, first by Lord Maur-Kon and, later, by Doctor Demonicus. Sherna and the other three Followers died when a giant alien monster attacked Shogun Sanctuary. The Agents of the Light arrived in their Shogun Warriors too late to save them but were able to kill the monster when it attacked them. The Agents then buried the bodies of the Followers in graves marked with ankhs on a mountaintop overlooking the ruins of Sanctuary. A month later, the Agents of the Light and the Fantastic Four confronted the alien Primal One who had sent the monster that killed the Followers. During the battle, the Primal One was revealed to be nothing more than a high-tech avatar that Maur-Kon was using to conceal his identity. Once exposed, Maur-Kon was swiftly defeated and taken into custody by the Charter Federation forces that his false Primal One had summoned, under false pretenses, to help him destroy the Shogun Warriors.

shetani.origin: Shetani was a member of the unnamed tribe in Kenya, son of their current leader. According to their traditions, the position of the leader was passed from mother to daughter, so Shetani felt left out. He left the village and joined the military and eventually became a Colonel. Years later Shetani encountered his niece Ororo Munroe and tried to kill her as a vengeance for his "mistreatment" by his mother and sister. Ororo defeated Shetani and learned from him about the hidden village and went there to meet her grandmother for the first time.

shevaun haldane.species: Human empowered with a piece of the fabric of the universe, new kind of mutant; Technology user
shevaun haldane.origin: Shevaun's father Ranulph was one of the Mys-Tech board members. She watched as Mephisto killed her father. Though her father kept secret from her the details of Mys-Tech, she felt responsible for the evil her father and his friends committed and swore that she would see Mys-Tech destroyed. A being calling itself Dark Angel approached her. Shevaun was given a fragment of the Fabric of the Universe, which attached itself to her flesh and became her costume, granting her enormous power and knowledge. As Hell's Angel, Shevaun battled the forces of Mys-Tech for many months, working with the X-Men and forming a close friendship with Psylocke. She also spent a large amount of time investigating the spirit realms, and allied herself with the fragmented souls of dead superhumans including Nighthawk and Nuke of the Squadron Supreme and Vakume of Salem's Seven. Shevaun came to the conclusion that the Darkangel had manipulated her and hidden details about her powers. thumbnail|200px|left|Absorbing the UnEarth Shevaun aided several other heroes in defeating Mys-Tech during the Mys-Tech Wars and absorbed the effects of the UnEarth to prevent the destruction of the Earth after Death's Head II and Wolverine slaughtered two of the members of Mys-Tech, and disrupted their delicate control over the Earth. She joined with Motormouth, Professor X, Death's Head II, Doctor Strange, and Albion to turn back time to before the Mys-Tech Wars, preventing Mys-Tech's plans and saving the world. Most recently, she has been seen working for Tony Stark as his mystical consultant, helping him with the Dark Bride and infiltrating Svartalfheim to take on Malekith the Accursed. During the events of Revolutionary War, a tired and frustrated Shevaun was found that paying her father's debt to Mephisto was elaborated plan by the Mys-Tech to come back through her fragment of the universe. Wanting to prevent this from coming to pass she made deal with Mephisto which played right into their hands.

fields.personality: Shevaun is generally an intelligent and laid-back person, spending most of her free time continuing her research while getting distracted watching old TV shows. After achieving Mys-Tech's good graces under the pretense of taking over her father's research position, her quick thinking has helped her avoid getting undermined by their restrictions on her authority, or even exposed as a traitor. She is a strong leader who has taken charge of the X-Men and Avengers on a whim. Although her relationship with the X-Men began as one of hostility, she accepted them soon out of necessity to have allies, and appreciates their comradery despite having to be secretive around them to protect herself. The unchanging purpose of her existence is to bring about the downfall of Mys-Tech, and she is well aware of this, displaying a strong sense of responsibility toward this mission. After being told that her father trafficked with demons and played a hand in sending the innocent souls of men, women, and children to Mephisto's Realm, she denied the news immediately, then accepted it by nighttime following hours of reflection. She considered it her destiny to bear her father's guilt as the sins of the parents are visited on children, motivating her to accept the shred of the fabric of the universe from Dark Angel with no hesitation. Her attitude towards her father has been mainly disaffectionate since discovering Mys-Tech's background, to the point where she wishes she had no parents altogether. Shevaun acts against Mys-Tech because her disgust at their fascism and genocidal nature trumps her familial loyalties. To that end, she has willingly aligned with non-heroes against Mys-Tech because they were all Britain had, and would go as far as killing every last member of Mys-Tech. Some examples of her utilitarian thinking include allowing her father to possess her for the sake of a mission despite wanting nothing to do with him, and bluntly telling Reed Richards to accept that as many heroes as necessary may have to give up their lives if it means stopping Mys-Tech. She also hates elves as she believes their culture celebrates murder, torture, and child-kidnapping, justifying this sentiment with a comparison to how sheep can't be too sympathetic to the plight of wolves. Her opinion of her father reached new lows as she found out that he performed brutal experiments on his own son, along with possibly more of his kin, and likely intended the same for Shevaun herself. In spite of everything, she refused to allow her father's soul to suffer in eternal damnation as he's still her flesh and blood, choosing instead to send him to another dimension to face judgement and redemption. She came to realize that the further she went down the path of challenging Mys-Tech, the more she let her father's madness and infernal nature reflect through her, so she vowed to create her own destiny. Her extreme principles have a limit, as she was willing to risk losing her father's soul and dangerous knowledge to Mys-Tech if it meant saving innocents. She has been upset about letting her anger get the best of her and nearly turn her into a killer, and has vowed not to do anything that harms innocent people, good people, or even morally iffy people.
equipment: Costume
weapons: Graviton Phase Blaster (alters time in an area), others.
fields.notes: Shevaun has a great deal of knowledge about melding magic and technology. After being empowered with a piece of the fabric of the universe, she was detected by Cerebro as a mutant of a new kind or strain. The void at the heart of Dark Angel has also been called the fabric of the multiverse. Her initial transformation by the Dark Angel was said in the narration to have recreated Shevaun's body, with her molecules encoded with the "molecules of infinity". She pulled out her original suit of armor from her own stomach. Shevaun was allowed to use the X-Men's Danger Room for training. When fighting a simulated version of Wolverine, the claws went right through her body, without harming her. Her body had become a void since her transformation, making her intangible. Among her first experiences as an adventurer was entering a portal to a section of the underworld inhabited by the souls of fallen superheroes (and a few villains). Soul fragments of the dead were waiting there, and could be recruited by Shevaun for missions. Shevaun had the powers of invisibility, teleportation, and intangibility. In addition, she could bestow these same powers to her allies. Shevaun initially served as an infiltrator within Mys-Tech's ranks, trying to convince everyone that she was continuing her father's research for the organization. Gudrun Tyburn noticed Shevaun during one of the younger woman's secret visits to Hell, and she had the opportunity to notify the others abut Shevaun's duplicity. Gudrun instead kept the information to herself. Shevaun could time-travel with her powers, and she initially attempted to change the past. After accidentally creating a dystopian alternate reality, she figured out the importance of the butterfly effect and decided to use her powers in more subtle ways. Shevaun had workaholic tendencies, and she had become a loner since the death of her father. Her new friend Psylocke invited her to a ladies' night out, trying to convince Shevaun that she needs to learn how to relax, to socialize, and to have some fun. When Shevaun was apprehended by members of Mys-Tech along with a group of renegade agents, Algernon Crowe tried to personally execute her. His bullet was telekinetically stopped by his teammate Gudrun Tyburn, who wanted Shevaun to survive the encounter. In a subsequent battle, Bronwen Gryffn tried to kill Shevaun. Gudrun incapacitated Gryffn and allowed Shevaun to escape. Shevaun realized that Gudrun was protecting her, but she had no idea what motivated the older woman to do so. Part of Shevaun's body could transform into a dimensional portal, which she used to exile her enemies to the Void pocket realm. This ability resembles Cloak's function as a living portal. Shevaun's inherited her father's debts to Mephisto, but the demon did not ask her for blood sacrifices or souls. Mephisto used her as a security officer for Hell, tasked with squashing rebellions against his own rule. During her return in 2014, Shevaun was said to have been empowered by Mephisto instead of the Dark Angel, giving him the ability to remove her powers at will. This was a strange retcon. Her powers were not depicted as hellish before, and Mephisto was surprised when interacting with her in her original series. He was seemingly unaware of her existence for some time. Shevaun had no known interactions with her unseen mother, and her original series hinted that she was created by Ranulph Haldane as part of his experiments with his own DNA. Online sources speculate that she was genetically engineered by Ranulph, and may have no actual mother. When originally depicted in her first series, Shevaun had a shaved, punk hairstyle, multiple piercings and a very large female symbol on her chest. In subsequent appearances, Shevaun was drawn with a more conventional and feminine style, but she turned into another look-alike for Jean Grey. Psylocke was depicted as Shevaun's best friend, and Shevaun even served breakfast in bed to her. Psylocke used the pet name "Von" for her pal. The reason for Gudrun Tyburn going out of her way to protect Shevaun was never explained. While online sources speculate that Gudrun is Shevaun's mother, the amoral sorceress may have deemed Shevaun as necessary for her power-grabbing plans. The Dark Angel who granted Shevaun her powers was said by the narrator to be a "master gamesman" (manipulator) and he was depicted laughing with a sinister glee when alone. But during a brief mind-link between them, Shevaun is convinced that he is benevolent in nature. What she read in his mind may have been an illusion. This Angel is also identified as the Angel of Death throughout Shevaun's original series. The handbook entries suggest that the Angel is either an alias of Azrael or an avatar of Death. Dark Angel named her pet cat "Lucifer".

shi qaanth.name: Shi Qaanth
shi qaanth.origin: Shi Qaanth was the most powerful of the Cotati and the favored lieutenant of the prophesized Celestial Messiah Quoi. His teachings were followed by many of the other Cotati and he was a powerful mage who could exert control on plant life. When Quoi declared the intention to wipe out all animal life and create their own realm called "Empyre", the first target of the Cotati was the planet Earth. Shi Qaanth drove the Man of Earth towards Mexico City, where Captain America and the Alliance-American attacked the Cotati forces accompanying the beast. The Alliance warships directed their missiles towards the beast and succeeded in greatly damaging him. However he soon retaliated and destroyed the Alliance flagship, while ripping open a fault line. Shi Qaanth restrained him with the power of his staff and he realized it must have been what was holding the Man of Earth together, before destroying it with his shield. shialmar.name: Shialmar
shialmar.origin: ===Early Life=== Shialmar was once a princess of a minor kingdom of the great land of Kaichek, apparently oppressed by the Sorcerer Kings. Thanks to the magic of the wizard Vung, the Black Mirror carried the former warrior Kan to their dimension in order to help Prince Jehan of Siridar (Shialmar's brother) defeating the Kings; Kan initially refused to return to his old ways and tried to convince the prince of pacefully deal with their enemies, meanwhile, Kan and Shialmar started a romantic relationship. When the woman was almost killed by a monster apparently sent by the Kings against them (but secretly sent by Vung, instead), Kan decided to help Jehan and led his army against the Sorcerers, but after killing them all, Kan and Shialmar realized how horrible was the war. Later, Vung captured them two and tried to sacrifice them to the N'Garai demons, but Shialmar offered his body to host the demons, they accepted turning her into the Shadowqueen. She then killed Vung, but the N'Garai weren't satisfied, as they wanted the sacrifice of someone she loved, Shialmar chose her brother, unable to hurt Kan, who was sent back to his universe. ===Life as Shadowqueen=== Centuries later, the Shadowqueen engaged a fight against the last of the Sorcerer Kings: Silver Fox; however, she decided to confront her power with the Sorcerer Supreme's one and in order to do so, she sent the Lords of the Golden Dragon kidnapping Wong and Clea. They're successful, but once in Shialmar's dimension, the girl was freed by Silver Fox's outlaws; when the Lords of the Golden Dragon failed in capturing Doctor Strange, Shialmar transformed them all into gargoyles and placed them guarding Wong's cell inside her prison. Meanwhile, Strange had joined Silver Fox's army and when the last Sorcerer King told him where Wong was, he decided to carry out a raid on the prisons at night, even if, as they entered Shialmar's city, Majaedong, the Shadowqueen always known where they was; because of that, when they escaped with Wong, the powerful witch was able to track them, leading her to Silver Fox's hidden camp. Using her mystical powers, Shialmar travelled through shadows until her enemies' camp and launched her attack with monsters that can turn everyone they touch into other monsters. The Shadowqueen decided to face Doctor Strange himself and their fight took place far in the sky, but that didn't forbid Wong trying to hit the evil witch with one of his arrows. He failed and the Shadowqueen hit him with one of her spells, but she was unable to kill him due to him looking like her lost love Kan; while distracted, Dr. Strange cast an extremely powerful spell that broke her link to the N'Garai Demons. Stephen then tried to heal her from the magic injures caused by the broken link, but Shialmar refused and died asking forgiveness for what she did as Shadowqueen.

shiela whittier.first_appearance: Giant-Size Chillers Featuring Curse of Dracula Vol 1 1
shiela whittier.origin: Shiela Whittier inherited castle Dunwick from her deceased "uncle" Alestar Duncan. Her boyfriend Freddy was killed when they went to go explore the castle. For two months Alestar's ghost tortured her as she lived at the castle. Dracula befriended Sheila as he hoped to later use her as his hypnotized slave to do his bidding in the daylight. Dracula banished Alestar's ghost who claimed that he was going to sacrifice Sheila to the dark gods and that he was not her uncle but in fact her father. He also claimed Sheila's mother was his murderer after he willed her the castle and that after death he assumed the form of another man and became her lover. Dracula and Sheila soon became involved in a relationship and she tricked David Eshcol into aiding Dracula. Sheila freed herself of Dracula's influence however and ran away with David Eshcol. She killed herself to escape from Dracula after he struck her and murdered Eshcol. Dracula lamented her death as he had come to love her.

shikata.first_appearance: Spider-Man: The New Animated Series Season 1 4
shikata.origin: Swordswoman Shikata was hired by wealthy businessman Richard Damien to kidnap and kill Spider-Man. When she couldn't promise that she wouldn't kill him, she refused his offer. In return, Damien sent hit-men to kill her, and almost did so until Spider-Man appeared. After being hunted, she went to Damien and decapitated him. Mary Jane later found her using the moonlight to regain her youth that she channeled through her sword. She later fought Spider-Man again and said that she would never stop until one of them is killed. Spider-Man grabbed the sword and destroyed it. As soon as it was broken, Shikata turned into mist and presumably died.

shilpa khatri.name: Shilpa Khatri
shilpa khatri.origin: Trinary was a young mutant from India who used her technopathic abilities to top up the accounts of every working Indian woman from the accounts of the twenty-five highest-earning CEOs in the country. Trinary's father reported her, and she was eventually caught and imprisoned by the Indian Mutant Defense Force. However, in anticipation for her capture, Trinary recorded a message asking Jean Grey for help. The message reached its recipient in Wakanda, resulting in Trinary's liberation from IMDF imprisonment by Jean Grey and her allies. Trinary took control of a Sentinel deployed by the IMDF and used it to escape with her rescuers. When they reached Wakanda, the mutant group was intercepted by Storm, secretly under the influence of Cassandra Nova. After Storm was incapacitated and the Sentinite controlling her was extracted from her brain with Trinary's help, Jean Grey decided to move her base of operations to Searebro. ===X-Men Disassembled=== Trinary was one of the many mutants that fought a crazed X-Man from remaking the world in his image. When X-Man felt that the world would never be improved with the X-Men around, X-Man made all his enemies vanish, including Trinary. While most of the X-Men were sent to a different plane of existence ruled by X-Man, Trinary wasn't one of them. Where she was during his time is unknown. ===House of X=== Trinary eventually returned and was living on the sovereign nation-state of Krakoa for mutants, created by Charles Xavier, Magneto, and Moira X. Moira and Charles Xavier tasked several technopath mutants such as Cypher, Sage, and Trinary with creating a system called "Sleeping Giant" to monitor for Nimrod technological thresholds being reached and/or the attempted creation of a "Mother Mold", a replicating, adaptive Sentinel factory that was self-aware and capable of creating other Sentinels. Xavier and Magneto then tasked the X-Men with destroying the Mother Mold and preventing the creation of Nimrod. With the help of Jean Grey and Monet St. Croix, Trinary coordinated the communication between team members and X-Men base in Krakoa. The X-Men accomplished their goal, but the entire team was killed in the attack thought later resurrected. Trinary remained in Krakoa and aided Magik in tracking down the creators of the anti-Mutant website Dox. Later, Monet St. Croix hired Trinary to be part of the board of the X-Corporation. ===X-Corps=== Trinary was one of the mutants recruited to X-Corps by Mirage following the Mutant Massacre at the Hellfire Gala. With Wiz-Kid, Trinary helped to run X-Corps Island and keep it cloaked from Orchis.

While most of the X-Men were sent to a different plane of existence ruled by X-Man, Trinary wasn't one of them. Where she was during his time is unknown. ===House of X=== Trinary eventually returned and was living on the sovereign nation-state of Krakoa for mutants, created by Charles Xavier, Magneto, and Moira X. Moira and Charles Xavier tasked several technopath mutants such as Cypher, Sage, and Trinary with creating a system called "Sleeping Giant" to monitor for Nimrod technological thresholds being reached and/or the attempted creation of a "Mother Mold", a replicating, adaptive Sentinel factory that was self-aware and capable of creating other Sentinels. Xavier and Magneto then tasked the X-Men with destroying the Mother Mold and preventing the creation of Nimrod. With the help of Jean Grey and Monet St. Croix, Trinary coordinated the communication between team members and X-Men base in Krakoa. The X-Men accomplished their goal, but the entire team was killed in the attack thought later resurrected. Trinary remained in Krakoa and aided Magik in tracking down the creators of the anti-Mutant website Dox. Later, Monet St. Croix hired Trinary to be part of the board of the X-Corporation. ===X-Corps=== Trinary was one of the mutants recruited to X-Corps by Mirage following the Mutant Massacre at the Hellfire Gala. With Wiz-Kid, Trinary helped to run X-Corps Island and keep it cloaked from Orchis.

shimata kawa.name: Shimata-Kawa
shimata kawa.origin: Shimata-Kawa was a man of Yamatai, though he was often erroneously referred to as originating from Khitai. As he arrived in Yezud with Ixastophanis, Shimata-Kawa helped Daedikaron and Tros freeing the captured Andamo, Welyn, and Moru. After killing a horde of Demons sent by Tolometh, Shimata-Kawa received a vision to search for the amulet in Aquilonia. Shimata-Kawa found himself in the Aquilonian fort of Venarium in Cimmeria, not long before the Battle of Venarium, where he was accidentally jostled by the young Conan. Blind, he briefly mocked Conan before mysteriously disappearing. Captured and tortured by the Grand Inquisitor of Ong, Shimata-Kawa eventually managed to free himself and Conan, to proceed towards the Desert of Yondo. He reunited there with Daedikaron, Tros, and Welyn He shared an amulet shard together with Conan; with him and the other seekers, he fought a Sand Devil in the Desert of Yondo and entered the Citadel of Sin. He was decapitated by the Patriarch of Tolometh's enchanted blade, although he managed to free its leathery sheath, which Conan used to kill him.

shingen harada.name: Shingen Harada
shingen harada.origin: ===Origin=== Shingen was a Japanese Yakuza crime boss who disgraced his family name by turning his clan into a criminal empire. He was the father of Wolverine's fiancee, Mariko Yashida. He had an illegitimate son named Kenuichio Harada, who was a mutant, and came to be known as the Silver Samurai. ===Facing Wolverine=== Shingen forced Mariko Yashida to marry another criminal boss who beat her nearly to death. When Wolverine found out about this, he confronted Shingen. Shingen then had Wolverine poisoned, temporarily greatly weakening him so that he could beat and humiliate the superhuman mutant in a duel with bokken in front of Mariko. left|thumb|200px|Shingen's deceit Shingen used his expert knowledge of human anatomy to secretly attack Wolverine's nerve endings in such a way so as to make the duel life-threatening. However, as Mariko did not know this, when Wolverine attempted to use his claws against Shingen to save his own life, it appeared to Mariko that Wolverine was cheating in the duel. Mariko did not know that Wolverine's body had been saturated with enough lethal poison to kill several dozen ordinary men or that Shingen was the one who was actually cheating in the duel. This had the effect of disgracing Wolverine in front of his lover, which was the design of Shingen. Shingen then ordered his operative Yukio to slay a rival crimelord named Katsuyori, who was planning to kill Hideki, Mariko's husband. Wolverine went with Yukio to kill Katsuyori. While there Wolverine went into a berserker rage and battled assassins. Wolverine then completely destroyed the Yashida criminal empire. Mariko fled back to her father’s stronghold. Repulsed by her father's crimes, Mariko vowed to kill him to prevent further dishonor from falling on Clan Yashida. When Wolverine attacked the stronghold, Hideki attempted to flee with Mariko, threatening to kill her unless he was allowed to escape. Mariko was saved by Yukio, who killed Hideki. When Wolverine confronted Shingen a second time, he then killed Shingen in a savage duel. With their deaths, this made Mariko head of Clan Yashida, and Mariko and Wolverine announced their engagement. Mariko and Wolverine however, did not marry; Mariko was at that time being controlled by the villain Mastermind, who was conducting a revenge campaign on the X-Men. She succeeded her father in command of the Clan. ===Return=== Shingen was resurrected many years later by the woman known as Phaedra. ===Hell=== Although it seems his resurrection was only temporary since he appeared in Hell alongside many of Wolverine dead foes and friends later on. After the criminal organization known as The Red Right Hand sent Wolverine's soul to Hell, Shingen was sent by Satan to fight against his old foe alongside several villains killed by Wolverine through the years.

shingen harada ii.name: Shingen Harada II
shingen harada ii.origin: ===Early Life=== Born and raised in Japan, Shingen "Shin" Harada was the illegitimate son of Kenuichio Harada and as such the heir of the Clan Yashida. He was also the boyfriend of Amiko Kobayashi, the foster daughter of Wolverine. ===Hellfire Academy=== At some point, he joined Kade Kilgore's Hellfire Academy, and partnered with Mystique in order to recruit the newly activated mutant Iara Dos Santos, who soon after adopted the code-name Shark-Girl, unsuccessfully, after having battled both their target and Angel. He designed the new Hellfire Academy. thumb|Unmasked ===Confronting Dario Agger=== As CEO of Yashida Corporation, Shingen represented the company at the Universal Bank, where the richest people met to discuss anything relevant to the world. In this meeting, the heads of various companies came from across the globe to confront Dario Agger regarding Roxxon's operations in the Ten Realms, which Agger had kept secret from them. As Agger was unwilling to share the market he had just opened, and threatened anyone who dared to step up and take it from him, Shingen then accepted Agger's offer of taking the new market by force and told Agger this was now a hostile takeover. He then used his resources to sabotage Roxxon's global pipeline, had a spy break into Agger's corporate H.Q. to download a virus, and hacked into his personal cloud where Shingen revealed Agger's tan lines. Shingen then morphed into his Silver Samurai armor and threatened to slice Agger's head off. Just when Agger was about to transform into a minotaur and fight Shingen, Exterminatrix, of the Midas Foundation, arrived and knocked him out cold with 20,000 volts of electricity, and declared herself as the newest member of the group thereafter.

After Wolverine left, the oyabun vowed to make him pay.

shinji yokohama.name: Shinji Yokohama
shinji yokohama.origin: After the death of her parents, Shinji Yokohama raised his niece Akiko. When Shinji began working as a campaign manager for Ken Takahara, he hired Akiko and made her the campaign speechwriter. Ken was trailing ten points behind Itaru Ozu with no chance of catching up, which caused Shinji to order a hit on Ken through the Bonsai Master. After Ken was killed, Akiko persuaded her uncle to run in Ken's stead, convinced that it was her idea. Akiko soon came to suspect that Ozu was behind Ken's assassinaton. Eventually she accused him of it in public, causing a scandal and forcing Shinji to fire her from the campaign. Shinji eventually won the election and became the new Prime Minister, but learned that Hit-Monkey was coming for him and became overcome with guilt, eventually revealing to Akiko the truth. When the Monkey finally came face to face with Shinji, he was persuaded not to kill him by Bryce. Detective Haruka then tried to arrest Shinji when he grabbed her gun and tried to shoot her. The Monkey had no choice but to kill him, earning Akiko's unending hatred.

shinko yamashiro.name: Shinko Yamashiro
shinko yamashiro.origin: Shinko Yamashiro was the sister of Takuya, the man who would become Spider-Man. She worked with her father Hiroshi and his observatory and witnessed the arrival of Marviller to earth. Amazoness posed as the editor to Hitomi Sakuma and asked her to get in contact with the professor and investigate the Marviller. Hiroshi, Shinko and Hitomi traveled to the crash site of the Marviller and were attacked by Boukunryu. Hiroshi was fatally injured and was found by Takuya and with his dying words, asked Takuya to stop the invaders. After her father's death, Shinko noticed her brother was acting strangely but was uncertain why. Unbeknownst to her, he had taken on the identity of Spider-Man and had began his quest for vengeance against the Iron Cross Army which had killed their father.

shinobi shaw.name: Shinobi Shaw
shinobi shaw.origin: thumb|150px|left|Shinobi and his mother ===Origin=== Shinobi's mother was romantically involved with both Sebastian Shaw and Harry Leland. When she learned what she was pregnant, she informed Sebastian about it, who assumed what the child was his. For the most of his following life Shinobi Shaw was treated as Sebastian's illegitimate son. During his childhood, Shinobi sometimes attended the Hellfire Club's parties, where he got acquainted with Warren Worthington III (the future X-Man Angel), who also accompanied his father. Over time, however, the two grew apart. ===Rising in power=== At some point, Shaw became a member of the Upstarts, a group of young mutants organized by Gamesmaster that were competing to see who could kill more mutants. As part of this contest, Shinobi visited his father in Switzerland and killed him (or so he thought), thus inheriting his father's empire and his network of social and political connections, including his position as a leading member of the Hellfire Club's Inner Circle. Shinobi attempted to revive the Hellfire Club's Inner Circle with his old friend Warren and his fellow X-Man Psylocke, but they refused his offer. Shaw's next contest with the Upstarts involved assassinating the surviving New Mutants and Hellions, but their plans were thwarted by the combined effort of X-Force and the New Warriors. Although Shaw briefly managed to obtain the assistance of several mutant associates, his frequent violent conflicts with other superhumans ultimately resulted in his failure to establish himself as his father's successor. Once he learned that his father was still alive, Shaw, presumably in fear of retaliation for his assassination attempt, deserted all of his inherited positions and returned to a more secretive mode of life. ===Dark times=== As a result of the Scarlet Witch's actions, nearly all of the mutants in the entire world were stripped of their powers, but Shinobi was among the 198 mutants cataloged to have retained their powers. Still, Shinobi was eventually killed by his father, but, along with many other deceased mutants, he was resurrected by Selene and Eli Bard with the Transmode Virus. left|thumb|Shinobi killing himself Years later, he rejoined the Upstarts, and together they killed the Nasty Boys. When the X-Men arrived to investigate the scene, Shinobi revealed that his actions were meant to protect the Nasty Boys from falling into Emma Frost's hands. Surrounded by the X-Men and unwilling to surrender, he simply phased his hand into his head and committed suicide. ===Krakoa=== Shinobi was again resurrected, this time by the Five in Krakoa, after his father requested them to do so. Sebastian wanted to reconnect with his son and make him the new Red King of the Hellfire Club, but, after Emma Frost (the White Queen) told him that she had already picked a Red Queen (Kate Pryde), he made Shinobi the Black Bishop instead. Still, Sebastian didn't plan to share the reign of the throne with the two queens and secretly killed Kate, hoping the Five wouldn't be able to revive her. When Emma found out, she began planning her revenge on Sebastian, but first, she intended to make sure no one else was involved: she telepathically commanded Shinobi to meet her and probed his mind, but, after finding out he was ignorant to his father's plans, she let him go. At some point Sebastian learned that Shinobi was not biologically his son, but instead was a son of Harry Leland. When Leland was resurrected on Krakoa, Sebastian organized their meeting and informed both the shocked Shinobi and the happy Leland about the truth. In the aftermath of the third Hellfire Gala, after Orchis had begun to openly pursue the total annihilation of mutants, Sebastian once again chose his own self-interest above all and had cut a number of backroom deals with the organization. As part of his bargain, Sebastian had guaranteed safe passage and sanctuary in Madripoor for Orchis' founder, Killian Devo, with the latter planning to lay low and rebuild operations after the war. With the Shaws seemingly in alliance with the humans, Shinobi was tasked with leading the Reavers in forcefully clearing out the Madripoor properties Sebastian had purchased on the city-state's waterfront. Shinobi privately disagreed with his father's decisions, however, and ultimately made the choice to side with mutantkind. Upon arriving at the island, Shinobi promptly found Shadowkat and shared details of the elder Shaw's double-dealing plans, warning her of Devo's impending arrival.

shinobu kageyama.name: Shinobu Kageyama
shinobu kageyama.origin: ===Early Life=== Shinobu Kageyama (影山しのぶ, Kageyama Shinobu) lived with his family in Kirisaki City, in the superstate of Hi no Kuni. Born a mutant bestowed with innate telepathic abilities and capable of awakening dormant X-genes in his kind , he showed signs of mental illness from an early age. Inability to control his abilities led to his mother's mental breakdown, driven to insanity by exposure to Kageyama's dark thoughts, which made her attempt to end his life. However, Kageyama was under the protection of an external entity with whom he had formed a personal connection and considered a friend, the Shadow King. Shinobu was eventually inducted into the Children of the Atom, a mutant cult that operated publicly as a religious institution. There, he underwent training to master his abilities and was instilled with a belief in an inherent superiority given to him by his status as a mutant , considered special by the Maester of the cult for his capabilities. In 2022, Kageyama began attending Kirigaya Minami Middle School, where he developed romantic feelings for his classmate, Hisako Ichiki , seeing her as an equal because of her inner struggle to fit in with those around her. He once sneaked uninvited into a game of Kokkuri-san played between Hisako and another classmate, Sayaka, just to get a closer look at her. When Hisako's best friend Tsubasa became increasingly depressed over being the target of bullying, she dropped his gifted Omamori and Kageyama gave it to her in public. She rejected it out of social pressure, hurting Tsubasa's feelings, and a month later, he went to Shinobu for advice. Using his telepathic abilities, Kageyama mentally suggested Tsubasa to commit suicide, which he did. Sometime in 2023, Kageyama attempted to perform a ritual on a cat, who managed to escape outside and subsequently encountered the recent arrival in the neighborhood, Mei Igarashi. Upon Igarashi's return of the cat, Shinobu employed his abilities to provoke the cat into a state of aggression, which led to the cat's violent scratching of Mei. This manifested latent mutant abilities in Mei later that day, which mimicked those of a source of inspiration for her, an African freedom fighter in the Upper and Lower Kingdoms.

Shinobu was inspired by Shinichiro Azuma, a 14-year-old Japanese serial killer and sexual sadist responsible for the controversial in 1997.
fields.trivia: Shinobu's first name means "stealth," while his family name, Kageyama, means "shadow" depending on the kanji it is written in, alluding to his mutant powers.

shir ydrn talonis.origin: ===Origin=== Shir Ydrn Talonis, or "Talon", was a sentient Raptor Mechanoid built by the Shi'ar centuries ago. Talon first encountered Darkhawk (Chris Powell) when he crashed into Chris's backyard while on the run from a Hunter Drone that he claimed was sent by those who opposed the work and goals of the Fraternity of Raptors. ===H'jke Jeeku=== Talon's Amulet was found in space by Skrull Commander H'jke Jeeku, one of the Skrull warriors who took part in the Skrull Invasion of Earth. After their defeat Commander Jeeku led his fleet to refuge in the Aranko Nebula. The fleet however was intercepted by the Inhumans and were decimated by Black Bolt's deadly scream. Commander Jeeku was the sole survivor. Moments before his death, he saw a bizarre crystal. Believing his mind was playing tricks on him, he approached this mysterious light, but as soon as he touched it, he was absorbed by the crystal.

shirlee bryant.name: Shirlee Bryant
shirlee bryant.origin: Shirlee Bryant was hired by Malcolm Donalbain to be a spokesmodel for his new chain of health emporiums. She found that although she was hired as "arm candy," he suffered from severe haphephobia (the fear of being touched) so she had to strictly avoid touching him. When he met with Dr. Joanne Tumulo about some research she had done on the motor response at the University of Chicago, looking for some amelioration, she was unable to help. However, he became fascinated with a private experiment she was conducting, to allow any woman to totally fulfill her physical and mental potential, and agreed to subsidize it. When the experiment was ready, he insisted on Shirlee to be its "first lovely guinea pig." Dr. Tumulo had planned to use her lab assistant, Greer Grant, as her first subject. When Dr. Tumulo threatened to cancel the experiment, Greer volunteered to secretly undergo the treatments alongside Shirlee. The experiment exceeded their expectations. Both women emerged with superhuman abilities. thumb|left|100px|Shirlee in the Cat Suit Donalbain had Shirlee use her new eidetic memory to record and duplicate the doctor's equipment. He planned to eliminate the doctor and her assistant once he had his own conditioning machine. He also had further plans for Shirlee: dressed in a cat-like uniform, she was to be the first of an army of enhanced women who would carry out his orders. Although Shirlee objected to the "Hallow'een costume," as she put it, he promised her they'd see eye-to-eye after she'd finished the outfit with a studded choker. The collar was more than merely decorative as it was a "will nullifier" that reduced the wearer to a state of zombie-like obedience. Completely under Donalbain's control, Shirlee followed his orders to climb to the top level of the six-story atrium, using her uniform's claws to dig into the beams. Then he ordered her to cast her claw-hook ahead of her and use it to swing across to the other side. Dr. Tumulo, dissatisfied with Shirlee's results in comparison to Greer's, had determined to end the experiment. She arrived just in time to secretly observe Shirlee fall to her death. It was impossible to tell whether the equipment malfunctioned or if Shirlee's diminished condition led to her failure. However, Donalbain raved that she was incompetent and he would create as many more prototypes as he needed.

shirley baylor.name: Shirley Baylor
shirley baylor.origin: Shirley Baylor was originally a cadet in the XSE, from the same class as Bishop, Shard, and Fitzroy. She and Bishop fought off an attack by Emplates when their instructors were killed in the field. Something drove Shirley away from Bishop and the X.S.E., however. By the time Bishop was an adult, Shirley had become Shackle, a private bodyguard for The Witness. She appeared particularly bitter and hostile towards Bishop for unexplained reasons.

shirley booth.name: Shirley Booth
shirley booth.origin: Shirley Booth is the daughter of the newspaper editor that employed Deadline Dawson in the 1940s. She fancied herself a bit of a detective and with her pet parrot Gossip hoped to show up local boy detective Terry Vance. She got the opportunity in the spring of 1943 when Deadline Dawson was assigned by his boss to keep an eye on her. She insisted on meeting Deadline's friend Terry Vance whom she openly mocked and claimed to be the better detective. To try and prove this, she left a note with hidden clues revealing the details of the case she was trying to crack and left it with a challenge to Terry to try and figure it out for himself. She was following local mobster Snake-Eye Smith whom the authorities could not pin any crimes to. She hid herself aboard his yacht hoping to uncover proof about his smuggling operation. Terry managed to trace the clue to Snake-Eye Smith's yacht and with the help of his ape Dr. Watson uncovered that Smith was smuggling ties during a rubber ration due to the War. Snake-Eye Smith was arrested and everyone went home safe, with Shirley not being able to keep out of trouble in the future. Her subsequent activities are unknown, but it seems that she grew out of detective work as she has not interacted with Terry Vance since.

shirley defabio.name: Shirley DeFabio
shirley defabio.origin: Growing up on the mean streets of South Side, Chicago, Shirley learned how to fight from her older brothers. She eventually got a job as Congressman Pug McCuskey's secretary. It was as McCuskey's secretary that she eventually met World War II hero and CIA field officer Nick Fury. She and Fury quickly started an affair, sleeping with each other multiple times a year. McCuskey asked Shirley to marry him, to which she agreed, rationalizing that McCuskey could give her the comfortable lifestyle that she always wanted and Fury could not. She came to despise McCuskey as he would routinely cheat on her with prostitutes, clearly displaying that he did not care about her.

shirley randal.origin: Shirley Randal worked in the secret prison facility that housed Absorbing Man. Shirley was mind controlled by Absorbing Man to make advances on Dr. Riley but he switched bodies and Dr. Riley forced himself on Shirley. Other members of the facility interveened and Shirley was taken to the infirmary.

shiro yoshida.name: Shiro Yoshida
shiro yoshida.origin: ===Early Years=== thumb|250px|left|Japan's atomic champion Shiro Yoshida was born into the influential Clan Yashida, who operates in Agarashima, Japan. His mother, a survivor of the atomic bombing in Hiroshima, died on the night of his birth. Raised under the influence of his uncle, Tomo, Shiro was indoctrinated into hating the Western world. When visiting the ruins of Hiroshima with his uncle, Shiro had his mutant powers activated, turning him into a raging furnace of atomic fire. Trained by his uncle in the use of his abilities, he was given a costume that evoked Japan's imperial colors. As Sunfire, Shiro, alongside his uncle, planned to get revenge against his enemies, the Americans. However, Shiro's father, Saburo, as one of Japan's greatest ambassadors, advocated for pacific relations with the West, which led him to disapprove his son's vindictive tendencies. Regardless, Sunfire attacked the United Nations Plaza during a diplomatic ceremony held by his father, where he was stopped by the X-Men Beast, Angel, and Iceman, who had detected his mutant signature. After escaping, he attempted to destroy the Capitol Building, but was fended off this time by the X-Men Cyclops and Marvel Girl. During the conflict, Saburo was murdered by Tomo. In a burst caused by his immediate grief, Sunfire murdered his own uncle in retaliation. As his last words, Saburo asked Shiro to live for the future and to fight for peace. A divided Sunfire returned orphaned to the land of the rising sun. In Tokyo, he met the Dragon-Lord, who sought to restore Japan's status as a world power by threatening the world and found in Sunfire an agent for his goals. On the island of Krakinowa, Sunfire was caught in a conflict with Namor the Sub-Mariner when one of the Dragon-Lord's prisoners made contact with Namor's ally, Betty Prentiss. Later, as Sunfire was sent to capture an American cargo ship, Namor intervened. However, Sunfire ultimately burned the ship down. As destruction ensued, Sunfire realized the ramifications of his actions and was convinced by Namor to team up with him to rescue the shipwrecked and defeat the Dragon-Lord. After the Dragon-Lord was defeated, Sunfire attempted to have a revenge against Namor, though he failed miserably. They would clash again when Captain America and Namor battled in Osaka over a piece of the Evil Eye during the conflict between the Avengers and the Defenders. Sunfire interrupted them and took the Eye for himself feeling neither of them had the right to fight over it in his homeland. He held it for a moment before Namor knocked him out of the sky, causing it to fall into Captain America's hands. In order to regain his honor in Japan, Sunfire took it upon himself to advance Japan's reconstruction work in Vietnam. There, a Vietnamese Major proposed an agreement for him to eliminate Iron Man to gain top priority from his government, which was just a deception to off the golden avenger for his benefit. Sunfire gladly agreed, considering taking out the bodyguard of Tony Stark, whose corporation rivaled those of Japan's. When Sunfire ambushed Iron Man and Roxie Gilbert, the two heroes fought until Sunfire was suddenly teleported to the Mandarin's underwater base. Mandarin, trapped in the Unicorn's dying body, baited the trapped Sunfire into powering his Mind-Exchange Machine to return him and Unicorn to their proper bodies. As Iron Man attacked the Mandarin's base, Sunfire realized the potential for his escape. However, the ensuing destruction of Iron Man and Mandarin's fight resulted in the base flooding, and Sunfire nearly drowned, only to be freed with Iron Man's assistance. Later, Sunfire endeavored to defeat Ultimo, whom Mandarin summoned to take back his castle from the Yellow Claw. He had very little success, though, due to using up most of his solar power earlier in his escape. Sunfire tried to use his remaining solar power to fly away, but he wasn't fast enough and ended up in its grasp. Fortunately, Iron Man managed to free him once again, and they worked together again to trick the alien robot into burying itself under a mountain. As Sunfire parted ways with Iron Man, seeing him as an ally and reconsidering his views of America. ===X-Men=== When most of the original X-Men were trapped by Krakoa, Sunfire was one of the mutants recruited by Professor Charles Xavier to rescue his original students. Though he had no interest in joining other mutants, Sunfire agreed by feeling honor bound and wishing to reintroduce himself as a warrior to the world. During the mission, Sunfire formed an assault team with Nightcrawler. The rescue was a success but, right after the mission, Sunfire left the team, alleging his loyalty lied with his country only and departing on bad terms with the X-Men. Sunfire gladly agreed, considering taking out the bodyguard of Tony Stark, whose corporation rivaled those of Japan's. When Sunfire ambushed Iron Man and Roxie Gilbert, the two heroes fought until Sunfire was suddenly teleported to the Mandarin's underwater base. Mandarin, trapped in the Unicorn's dying body, baited the trapped Sunfire into powering his Mind-Exchange Machine to return him and Unicorn to their proper bodies. As Iron Man attacked the Mandarin's base, Sunfire realized the potential for his escape. However, the ensuing destruction of Iron Man and Mandarin's fight resulted in the base flooding, and Sunfire nearly drowned, only to be freed with Iron Man's assistance. Later, Sunfire endeavored to defeat Ultimo, whom Mandarin summoned to take back his castle from the Yellow Claw. He had very little success, though, due to using up most of his solar power earlier in his escape. Sunfire tried to use his remaining solar power to fly away, but he wasn't fast enough and ended up in its grasp. Fortunately, Iron Man managed to free him once again, and they worked together again to trick the alien robot into burying itself under a mountain. As Sunfire parted ways with Iron Man, seeing him as an ally and reconsidering his views of America. ===X-Men=== When most of the original X-Men were trapped by Krakoa, Sunfire was one of the mutants recruited by Professor Charles Xavier to rescue his original students. Though he had no interest in joining other mutants, Sunfire agreed by feeling honor bound and wishing to reintroduce himself as a warrior to the world. During the mission, Sunfire formed an assault team with Nightcrawler. The rescue was a success but, right after the mission, Sunfire left the team, alleging his loyalty lied with his country only and departing on bad terms with the X-Men. Both "Yoshida" and "Yashida" seem to be correct spellings of his surname; however, while the word is plausible in the Japanese romanization system, "Yashida" as a family name does not exist. shiro yoshida moira ii 4.name: Shiro Yoshida (Moira-II.4)
shiro yoshida moira ii 4.origin: In a temporal offshoot of Earth-616 designated as Moira-II.4, Abigail Brand successfully saw her plan to start an intergalatic war to completion. However she underestimated and was betrayed by Orbis Stellaris, whose army simultaneously struck Arakko, Krakoa and Earth as a whole. Unprepared, most Avengers perished in the opening salvo, which killed most people on Earth and made the planet uninhabitable by stripping its atmosphere. A small group of Mutants survived by escaping to space on an Acanti-borne Arakko, ironically under the leadership of Brand herself. Sunfire and Redroot were never separated from one another, eventually merging into a single being called Rootfire. Allying with the Starjammers, Brand's X-Men survived for years, occasionally making supply runs to Earth's airless surface. During one such run they rescued and brought with them a group of their long-dead friends - time-traveling X-Men from another timeline. Progidy's power allowed him to absord Brand's memory and quickly bring his group up to speed on her timeline's history. Time-traveling X-Men asked to be brought back to the serface when the Technarchy attacked, send by Stellaris who was after the last mysterium in the universe that was kept by Brand's X-Men. They engaged the intruders in a fight, in which the Starjammers soon arrived to help, while the time-traveling X-Men proceeded with their own mission.

shiv counterfeiter.name: Shiv (Counterfeiter)
shiv counterfeiter.origin: The Shiv was a counterfeiter who was active in the 1940s. He earned his nickname due to his love of knives. By 1945 he and his gang had gotten into counterfeiting ration coupons that were common place during the war. When a FBI agent managed to infiltrate his gang with the help of a stoolie, Shiv soon found out and had both men executed. Their bodies were then placed in bags filled with books and dumped in a nearby alley. The bags were discovered by the Young Allies while they were on a scrap paper drive. Seeing the boys taking the body bags, Shiv and his gang tried to stop them but were held back by Toro's flame while the Allies escaped. When the Young Allies realized what they had, they then set up a trap for Shiv and his gang. With Bucky and Toro hiding in the sacks, the other Young Allies brought them back to the alley where they were found. Spotting the kids again, Shiv and his gang captured them and brought them back to their base where they revealed their operation. But, before they could kill the Young Allies, Bucky and Toro revealed themselves and the youths easily rounded up Shiv and his gang and turned them over to the authorities. Shiv's subsequent fate is unknown.

shiv gangster.first_appearance: Marvel Graphic Novel Vol 1 67: Wolverine: Bloody Choices
shiv gangster.origin: A mercenary who worked for drug-dealer Mr. Bullfinch. In the line of his work, he found himself confronted with Wolverine in a couple of fights, surprising the Canadian mutant with speed, stamina and strength comparable to his own. thumb|200px|left|Shiv extracts his "claws" in front of Wolverine It is not clear if any degree of superhuman abilities was involved, but Shiv has been able to lift with a single arm the 300 lbs heavy body of Wolverine. Besides the surprising resemblance between the two - only comparable to that shared with Sabretooth or Romulus - Shiv and Wolverine had apparently already met, though they both could not remember on which occasion. After having stated that he's a fast healer as Wolverine, Shiv has his head crashed through a concrete wall of a swimming-pool, emerging severely beaten but not unconscious. After that, he bargained his freedom in exchange for a tip-off on his boss's hideout. Since then, Shiv hasn't been seen anymore.

shoba mirza.name: Shoba Mirza
shoba mirza.origin: Shoba Mirza met Danny Ketch at a time when he was at the lowest point in his life. Shoba desperately needed the power of the Ghost Rider and heard Daniel was possibly the greatest of all time – although she wouldn't have known it from the drunken stupor she found him in. Knowing he was more interested in her looks then his sense of duty, Shoba left Danny to sober up while she dealt with the threat of Verminus Rex on her own. What she didn't know was Daniel had his friend Mary LeBow exorcise the Ghost Rider entity from his body, and without his powers, Daniel wouldn't have been much help anyway. Daniel didn't know much about where his powers came from, but an agent of Zadkiel changed all that. The minion showed Daniel he wasn't alone. There were other Spirits of Vengeance out in the world, and Verminus Rex was stealing their powers for himself. Shoba was next on his list, and Daniel was stunned when he witnessed her transformation into a Ghost Rider. Daniel, much like a drug addict, had been given small doses of the power he once held to make him pledge his allegiance to Zadkiel, and this time was no different. Ketch used the excuse of helping Shoba to get another fix, and his request was granted. Unfortunately, Daniel was sloppy, too engrossed in his quest for power instead of focusing on the big picture, and Shoba was taken prisoner. Daniel searched for her night after night, but it was Shoba that found him again once she escaped Rex's dimension. Wounded beyond repair, the entity inside her threatened to take control, and Shoba begged Daniel to rescue her. He wasn't sure what to do, but like a parasite, Ketch leeched her powers into himself. Shoba's human half had been saved, and she thanked Daniel even as she passed away in his arms.

shocket raccoon.name: Shocket Raccoon
shocket raccoon.species: Halfworlder Mutate female Clone of Rocket Raccoon
shocket raccoon.origin: Shocket was created by the Collector from genetic material of Rocket Raccoon, a prisoner of his collection, for reproductive purposes. When Rocket Raccoon and another inmate named Howard the Duck escaped, Shocket and Howard's clone Linda were put under the care of Gatherer D-3X until the escapees were recovered. Six months went by, and the Collector wasn't able to recover neither Rocket nor Howard, so Shocket and Linda were to be put in cryogenic stasis. D-3X had grown fond of both of them, so he rebelled against the Collector's mandate and escaped along with the kids. Three months later, Shocket, Linda and D-3X arrived to the planet Souqlon and, with the help of a rebel Space Phantom known as Multo, they escaped to the furthest they could go into the past, twenty-five years. Twenty years after their arrival to the past, the three fugitives had become smugglers. While they were conducting business, one of their clients recognized D-3X as the person who had kidnapped their parents, unaware that it had actually been his past/present self, and blasted him with a gun. Shocket, Linda, and D-3X escaped from their attackers, but D-3X's wounds were fatal, and he died subsequently. Five years later, the time for the escape of their present selves to the past was looming, meaning the Collector would start looking for them. Both both Shocket and Linda knew they couldn't keep going back in time, they needed to leave the universe. With the help of the Oracle of Omega, they were directed to the Nexus of All Realities.

shocks marley.name: Shocks Marley
shocks marley.origin: Shocks Marley, a stock car stunt driver and convicted murderer (he killed Ned Pearson). He wore a costume made by a witch woman from Haiti while being executed, and this turned him into the Apparition. As the Apparition, he attacked Johnny Blaze (mistaking him for Pete Catrones). Later he again attacked Blaze, along with Nora and Sonny Tremont, but Ghost Rider chased him off. Blaze was next attacked while riding in Sonny Tremont's car. shogo lee.name: Shogo Lee
shogo lee.origin: When the sentient bacteria Arkea traveled to Earth seeking revenge on her brother Sublime, she used a series of asteroids and meteors as her mode of transportation back to Earth. One of these meteors landed in Budapest, causing widespread destruction. The X-Man Jubilee, in Hungary at the time, adopted a baby orphaned by the meteor strike, whom she named Shogo. left|200px|thumb|Jubilee and Shogo at the train station Unbeknownst to Jubilee, Shogo was being used as a host by Arkea. Arkea used her ability of technopathy to possess machinery to stop a train they were traveling on and killed the drivers, although the intervention of the X-Men prevented any further loss of life. Arkea left Shogo's body after Jubilee arrived at the Jean Grey School, opting instead to use the body of Omega Sentinel as a way to take over the school's entire computer system. Sublime, who had followed Jubilee and Shogo to the school to warn the X-Men about his sister, explained that Shogo had essentially been "reset" upon Arkea leaving him - and also offered the opinion that Shogo was Jubilee's son. While the X-Men and Sublime tracked down and dealt with the Arkea threat in a specialized hospital in Budapest, Shogo and Jubilee stayed behind in a van. As Jubilee gave Storm and the team intel on the hospital's layout, she began to multitask by searching records to see if Shogo had any living relatives. By the time the X-Men and a now recovered Karima returned to the van, Jubilee explained with confidence that she was Shogo's mother. After a while, Jubilee's adoption paperwork came through and she officially became Shogo's new legal mother. When Jubilee began training a new generation of mutants, she was joined by her old teammate Jonothon Starsmore. They grew closer and, when Jubilee was impaled in the chest, Jono offered his arm for her to feed on, with Shogo accidentally witnessing everything. For a while after that, he wouldn't let Jubilee change him, hold him or comfort him, so Jono had to step in and do these things himself, but it wasn't long before things returned to normal. After Jubilee went missing for a while, Jono took care of Shogo by himself. During the first Krakoan Era, Jubilee discovered Shogo would transform into a dragon whenever he traveled to Otherworld, and, when he spent long periods without going back, he would get very melancholic.

shoji soma.name: Shoji Soma
shoji soma.origin: left|thumb|250px|The Zodiac (Great Wheel) (Earth-616)|Great Wheel In 1961, the Hand Grandmaster Shoji Soma was contacted by the Brotherhood of the Shield and was brought to the Immortal City to meet with Leonardo da Vinci in Pieta. Along with other intelligence agents from around the globe—Jake Fury, Magadan, John Garrett, Cornelius van Lunt, Nick Fury, Baron Strucker, Dum Dum Dugan, Thomas Davidson, the Kraken, and Orion—they formed the Great Wheel. Each member was assigned a codename from the zodiac, Soma being Pisces. Leonardo da Vinci was the leader as Aries, sent the rest of the Wheel on three key retrieval missions, and promised them resources that would be of great value to their own separate agendas. Shoji Soma took part in an operation along with John Garrett, Kraken and Magadan, infiltrated an ancient Brood vessel in Giza, Egypt, killed the Brood host and acquired a power source. The Great Wheel later fell apart due to the betrayal of Orion and Magadan of Leviathan. Shoji Soma and Baron Strucker united to attack Leviathan and severely wounded Orion; Magadan rushed Orion into stasis, but the superhuman process could not be carried out after Hydra and the Hand had stolen the Brood power source. Shoji Soma met with Lord Shigen and the Silver Samurai of Clan Yashida at Agarashima, and Soma hid the alien power source vital towards the revival of Leviathan inside a Yashida ancestral box. Despite Shigen's warning that no one who has opened the box has lived to see it closed, Soma knew that he was already dead. The next day, Magadan attempted to retrieve the power source in order to revive Orion, killing Shoji Soma in his search, but could not find it. Magadan and Leviathan went dark for many years.
